results.point_context:
### The Fairness Voice: Reading the Case File

An auditor opens an old case file. One company stopped an internal hiring tool after past resumes taught it to rate women lower in some cases. New York City requires a bias audit, a public summary, and notice to candidates before certain automated tools are used. The EU classifies AI for recruitment as high-risk, with rules on transparency and human oversight. But the legal picture is uneven: Japan did not have an equivalent audit law at the time examined. The reviewer asks whether a decision can be checked, not simply whether software can produce a score.
